Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the steady latency numbers. Before we lock dates for the activation sprint, procurement and infra have a few practical asks so we can size the pool and set realistic burst windows:  

- Primary region preference: us-west (we have customers in PDX and SFO).
- Peak QPS expectation: baseline 150 rps text-generation calls, spike up to 850 rps for a 90-minute marketing crawl window (estimated twice monthly).
- Mixed model footprint: 70% 8k context models, 30% 32k long-context variants.

I attached an initial mutual action plan (novaedge-MAP-v1.xlsx) with dates. Can you confirm whether you recommend a single multi-GPU pool in us-west with autoscale burst to a second pool, or two separate regional pools with routing? Procurement also asked for a short summary of what we need from netops for the cutover.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to get commitment on the reserved capacity by Aug 11.

Best,
Claire

Subject: Re: Capacity questions before kickoff

Claire — thanks, useful detail. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answer on topology: we generally recommend a primary pool in the region with the bulk of traffic (us-west) and a small warm standby in a second region for failover and controlled bursting. That gives best latency, reduces cross-region tokens cost, and preserves a deterministic autoscale path. Key considerations for you:

- Pool sizing: for the baseline + expected spikes we recommend starting with a 12x A100-equivalent pool (mixed partitions) and enabling burst policy to scale to 28x A100-equivalent during the 90-min windows.
- Model variants: we’ll advise a quantized 8k model for baseline and a higher-memory 32k variant only routed during burst windows to control cost.
- Routing policy: we’ll configure smart routing with latency-first for production traffic and cost-first for batch/async tasks.

Actions I can take this week:
1) Share a short requirements PDF for NovaEdge's netops (what CIDR/VPN rules, subnets, and peering we need) — attaching redwood-dedicated-reqs.pdf.
2) Draft a burst policy template with guardrails (max tokens/min, cooldowns, health checks).
3) Arrange a 30-min netops sync with our solution engineer Logan to walk the network asklist.

Can Logan and Priyom confirm availability for a Tuesday netops call? Also, Claire — if procurement can share the SOW draft or payment timeline that helps us finalize pool commit dates.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Park <claire@novaedge.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity questions before kickoff

Marissa / Logan — Tuesday works for me; I can also draft the burst-policy template and put concrete knobs on the numbers Marissa suggested. A couple of technical notes from infra perspective:

- Autoscale velocity: we can do continuous scaling with 3–5s reaction on queue depth for model dispatch, but warm-up for the 32k variant (KV-cache population) will add 60–90s before peak throughput is fully realized. For short 90-min windows that’s borderline; recommend a 10–15 minute warmup kickoff before expected spikes.
- Cost control: we should cap the 32k variant routing to no more than 40% of concurrent shards during a spike and prefer staged ramping to avoid cold starts.
- Failover plan: for region failover, we’ll keep a 2x small warm pool in us-east with pre-warmed models for critical customers; traffic shifting will be gradual to allow cache priming.

I’ll attach the draft burst-policy and include example autoscale curves. Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

2) Pool sizing & burst: start 12x A100-equivalent, burst to 28x for scheduled 90-min windows. Priyom to produce the concrete ramp profile and automated warmup job (15 min pre-warm).

4) Netops items: NovaEdge to provide CIDRs and SOW by Aug 6; Logan to run netops sync on Aug 7.
5) Activation sprint: tentatively Aug 15–22, finalize if SOW signs on Aug 11.
